evidence_items.publisher: Razeghi, Logan, Gardner and Singh / arXiv
evidence_items.locator: Section 1; methods in Section 2 and addition results in Table 2
evidence_items.explanation: The study finds addition accuracy associated with term and term-pair frequency in GPT-J and GPT-Neo. It compares more frequent with less frequent constituents, not matched complete equations known to be seen versus unseen; it also explicitly declines a causal interpretation.

The earlier report found 80.2% three-digit addition accuracy, while its search found matching expressions for only 17 of 2,000 addition problems. This cautions against assuming exact-example memorization, although the search covered limited expression formats and predates the target period.

unresolved_gaps: No matched seen-versus-unseen addition comparison was established by the cited 2022 study.
Term-frequency correlations do not settle whether partial algorithmic generalization coexists with memorization.
The retrieved direct GPT-3 contamination experiment falls outside the target period.
